_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the OpenMW-Web multiplayer server. Setup steps: deploy/pterodactyl/README.md
name: OpenMW-Web (Morrowind multiplayer)
author: michael@stavridis.xyz
description: Morrowind multiplayer in the browser. Players need Chrome or Edge on a computer, and the server must sit behind HTTPS. Game files are uploaded from the server's dashboard at /admin.

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Where accounts, worlds, config.toml and the game files live. Keep it inside the server's own volume.

variables.name: Listen port
variables.description: Leave empty on 1.7.6 and later (the allocation port is used). On older images set it to this server's allocation port.

variables.name: Node heap (MB)
variables.description: Memory cap for the server process itself. Each world's game process uses memory on top of this.
